description: Patch one to-do by exact todo_id. Omitted fields stay as they are; null clears due_date, due_time, description or goal_id. goal_id links it to a goal, null detaches it. Does not move calendar sessions. ($0.05; API key required)

due_time.description: HH:MM in the given time zone.

priority.description: Priority level: high, medium or low, e.g. medium.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

todo_id.description: Exact id from get_todos or create_todo. Titles are not accepted.
